title: ANCLINE ERP Completion Build
objective: Complete the approved ANCLINE Global Forwarding ERP business application before returning to production authentication work.
scope: complete missing or incomplete ERP screens and forms
complete same-page business workflows and action paths
repair broken or missing navigation, links and buttons
bind approved screens to authoritative existing APIs
complete operations, forwarding, NVOCC, finance, control, reporting and administration gaps already represented in the approved product
run realistic cross-module transaction validation using existing test jobs
fix verified in-scope functional, UI, data-integrity and workflow defects
invariants: preserve existing data model unless an additive fix is strictly required for an already-approved function
preserve API contracts unless an additive compatibility fix is strictly required
preserve maker-checker, four-eyes, segregation-of-duties and audit controls
impact-based tests during development and one final full UAT at the end
